Just Seal Pty Ltd is a specialist joint sealing company providing technical sealant solutions for commercial and residential construction projects.

We are seeking a full-time Engineering Consultant to join our growing team on the Gold Coast.

This role provides technical advice and specialist support across commercial, residential, remedial and marine joint sealing projects.

Key duties include:
-Assess construction substrates, joint design and movement requirements to determine appropriate sealant systems for each project.
-Provide technical advice on sealant selection, product compatibility, joint preparation and application methods for commercial and residential construction works.
-Conduct site inspections to identify sealant defects, adhesion failures, water ingress and movement-related issues, and recommend appropriate rectification solutions.
-Review project drawings, specifications and manufacturer requirements to ensure sealing systems meet technical and performance standards.
-Develop and implement quality assurance procedures, installation standards and technical documentation to support consistent project delivery.
-Prepare technical reports, site assessments, product recommendations and project documentation.
-Liaise with builders, architects, project managers, suppliers and clients to provide technical support and ensure compliance with project specifications and Australian Standards.
-Research and evaluate new sealant technologies, products and application methods to improve performance, durability and efficiency across the business.

Requirements:
-Relevant engineering qualification.
-Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
-Excellent communication and documentation skills.
-Experience in construction materials, building systems or related engineering fields is highly regarded.
-A commitment to quality, safety and continuous improvement.

result.description:
Job description
Position Summary
The Graphic Pre-press is responsible for preparing, processing and converting customer artwork, images, text and design files into print-ready formats for commercial printing, packaging, labels and other visual media applications. The role ensures all pre-press activities meet customer specifications, production requirements and quality standards before printing commences. 
Main Duties and Responsibilities
Artwork and File Preparation
•	Review customer artwork and design files for printability and technical compliance.
•	Prepare, manipulate and format text, graphics and images for printing and digital output.
•	Generate layouts, page impositions and print-ready files using specialised pre-press software.
•	Perform pre-flight checks to identify and correct file errors before production.
•	Ensure artwork complies with customer specifications, dimensions and production requirements. 
Image Processing and Colour Management
•	Scan, edit, retouch and optimise digital images.
•	Perform colour correction, colour separation and colour matching processes.
•	Apply colour management systems and profiles to achieve accurate print reproduction.
•	Evaluate colour consistency and quality throughout the pre-press process. 
Proofing and Quality Control
•	Produce digital and hard-copy proofs for customer approval.
•	Review proofs against artwork specifications and printing requirements.
•	Identify and rectify errors relating to colour, positioning, text, image quality and layout.
•	Maintain quality assurance standards and compliance with company procedures. 
Plate and Output Preparation
•	Operate computer-to-plate (CTP) and other plate-making systems.
•	Prepare printing plates, films and digital output devices for production.
•	Ensure output files are compatible with printing equipment and workflows.
•	Monitor and maintain pre-press production systems and equipment. 
Production Support
•	Liaise with customers, designers, printers and production staff regarding artwork requirements.
•	Provide technical advice on print limitations, artwork preparation and production specifications.
•	Assist in troubleshooting pre-press and printing issues.
•	Support continuous improvement initiatives within the printing production workflow. 
________________________________________
Key Accountabilities
•	Accurate preparation of artwork and print-ready files.
•	Compliance with production schedules and customer deadlines.
•	Maintenance of colour accuracy and print quality standards.
•	Reduction of printing errors and production waste.
•	Efficient operation of pre-press systems and software.
•	Compliance with workplace health and safety requirements.
•	Effective communication with customers and internal stakeholders.
________________________________________
Typical Skills and Knowledge
•	Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign).
•	PDF workflow management.
•	Pre-flight and imposition software.
•	Colour management systems and ICC profiles.
•	Computer-to-Plate (CTP) technology.
•	Print production processes including offset, flexographic and digital printing.
•	Quality assurance and proofing procedures. ________________________________________
Qualification Level
ANZSCO Skill Level 3
•	Typically requires:
•	AQF Certificate III in Printing and Graphic Arts (Pre-press) with relevant on-the-job training; or
•	AQF Certificate IV qualification; or
•	At least three years of relevant industry experience may substitute for formal qualifications in some circumstances.
Salary & Career Outlook
• Salary: Range from $75,000 to $85,000 per year, depending on the specific industry and experience level.

Relevate is a Brisbane-based operations, strategy and technology consulting firm that helps businesses unlock the full value of their software. We work across CRM implementation, IT managed services, virtual staffing and digital transformation advisory, with particular depth in the Zoho ecosystem. Plenty of firms can install software; our real point of difference is adoption. We make sure the people using the tools genuinely embrace them, because that is where return on investment is actually realised. Our work is practical and outcome-driven. We have helped clients cut integration costs, reduce monthly licensing spend and reclaim days of manual reporting time each month simply by rethinking how their systems fit together. In short, we help teams work smarter rather than harder, so our clients become more profitable, more valuable and more resilient.

•	Serve as a first point of contact for clients experiencing issues with their CRM, business applications or supporting hardware, diagnosing problems and delivering timely resolutions
•	Assess client needs and recommend suitable software, hardware and system configurations to resolve operational challenges and close value gaps in their business tools
•	Customise and adapt existing applications, including Zoho Creator apps, CRM workflows and automations, so they align with each client's specific processes
•	Install, configure and deploy Zoho modules and other business software across client environments, ensuring each solution is set up correctly for the way the client works

•	Escalate complex or unresolved matters to senior consultants and collaborate with the wider team to deliver solutions
•	Provide both remote and on-site support to clients as needed, and assist virtual staffing team members with the tools and systems they rely on

Hours and Remuneration

If you enjoy solving problems, helping people and working with modern business technology, we would love to hear from you.
